plugins.description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 26 skills, 28 commands across 6 numbered phases (GROUND → DISCOVER → DIAGNOSE → FORTIFY → BUILD → LAUNCH). Phase.step addresses (0.1–5.4) grounded in NNG design thinking and visual design process. Phase Position headers, sequential Next Steps, dual UX + commercial milestones. Visual design mastery (36+ world-class designers, 70 canonical rules, 10-dimension Awwwards-calibrated scoring), platform visual standards (iOS 26 Liquid Glass, M3 Expressive, modern CSS 2025-2026, 9 device types), AI design generation (Stitch MCP, Fal.ai 600+ models, Recraft V3 SVG, Veo 3.1 video), UI pattern intelligence (200+ patterns, 50+ product benchmarks, 100+ anti-patterns), NNG process workflow, heuristics, cognitive psychology, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, WCAG 2.2+3.0, mobile/desktop/web/watch/TV/spatial/automotive, AI/spatial/voice UX.
